name: Shop suspension, handmade or reselling policy
distinguishing_phrases: Etsy is a marketplace for handmade

intake.label: What date did Etsy suspend the shop?
intake.why: The appeal opens with the shop name and the date.

intake.label: What is your shop name?
intake.why: Etsy matches appeals by shop name.

intake.label: Describe exactly how your items are made, step by step.
intake.why: Etsy's handmade policy is about your role in the process. Vague craft language is what gets these rejected.

intake.label: Where do you buy your materials and blanks?
intake.why: Buying blanks is allowed. Buying finished goods is not. The appeal has to make the difference obvious.

intake.label: Do you use a production partner, and is it declared on every listing?
intake.why: An undeclared production partner is the single commonest true cause of this suspension.

intake.label: Who designed the items?
intake.why: The policy requires the seller to design or make. Naming the designer resolves most of the question.

intake.label: Do any of your listings use words like wholesale, dropship, stock or resale?
intake.why: Automated checks flag this language regardless of what you actually do.

intake.label: What have you already changed in your listings or partner declarations, and on what dates?

evidence.label: The suspension email
evidence.why: We quote the policy Etsy named.

evidence.label: Photographs of your workspace and the item at each stage of making
evidence.why: The strongest evidence in a handmade case. Unstaged, in sequence, with the item recognisable.

evidence.label: Invoices for materials, blanks or components
evidence.why: Shows you buy inputs rather than finished goods.

evidence.label: Your production partner agreement, if you use one
Your design files, sketches or patterns
evidence.why: Evidences that you designed the item.

sections.heading: What the shop sells and how it is made
sections.guidance: The making process step by step, naming tools, materials and where each input comes from.

sections.heading: How the shop meets the handmade policy
sections.guidance: Address design ownership and production partner declaration directly, with the attached evidence named.

sections.heading: What has changed
sections.guidance: Dated bullets: partners declared, listing wording corrected, photographs added.

sections.heading: Evidence attached
sections.guidance: One line naming each attachment and what it shows.

output.opening: One sentence naming the shop, the policy Etsy cited and the suspension date.
output.closing: One short line offering any further document Etsy needs.

rejection_patterns.fail_message: Etsy's appeal box takes 2000 characters. Anything longer is cut off mid sentence.

rejection_patterns.check: The appeal describes the making process step by step with named tools and materials.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: The appeal describes the craft in general terms. The policy is about your specific role in making the item.

rejection_patterns.check: Where a production partner is used, the appeal states that it is now declared on every listing, with the date.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: An undeclared production partner will be found. Declare it and say when you did.

rejection_patterns.check: No paragraph scores above 0.6 for genericity.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This paragraph could belong to any shop. Etsy Trust and Safety reads hundreds of these a day.

rejection_patterns.check: None of: unfortunately, I assure you, please give me one more chance, loyal seller, unfair.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This phrase appears in rejected appeals more than in accepted ones. Remove it.

rejection_patterns.check: No [MISSING: ...] markers remain in the draft.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A required fact is missing. Answer the question or upload the photographs.

rejection_patterns.check: Process photographs are in the confirmed evidence.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: Without process photographs this appeal rests on your description alone.
A correction with no date reads as a promise, not an action taken.

submission.where: The appeal link in Etsy's suspension email, or Etsy Support, Contact us
steps: Open the suspension email and use the appeal link it contains.
Paste the appeal as plain text within 2000 characters.
Attach process photographs and materials invoices.
submission.turnaround: Etsy typically replies within 3 to 7 days.
